distance_note: The San Francisco Chronicle describes the site as one block from the Potrero Power Station redevelopment. By street address, it is closer to two blocks: the parcel fronts Michigan St between 24th and 25th, while the nearest currently-tracked Potrero Power Station parcel (the Sophie Maxwell Building, 1212 Maryland St) fronts Maryland St between Humboldt St and 23rd -- a block and a half to the north across 24th St.
summary: A 4-acre industrial parcel at 1215 Michigan St, currently home to crane-rental and heavy-hauling firm Sheedy Drayage, that the San Francisco Chronicle reported (Sept 2026) may become a roughly 160,000-square-foot data center. No application had been filed with SF Planning as of that report.

milestones.text: San Francisco Chronicle reports Nestory Park Capital met with city officials to discuss permits for a data center at the site; no application filed with SF Planning as of this report, and the property has not changed hands.

how_to_comment.detail: Search block/lot 4241004 for any case filed on this parcel (none was on file as of Sept 2026).
No hearing is scheduled yet; check once a case number is assigned.

positions.who: Supervisor Shamann Walton (District 10, which includes this parcel)
positions.statement: Said he was unaware of the plans for 1215 Michigan St when contacted by the Chronicle. On data centers near residential neighborhoods generally: "We are seeing data centers pop up near residential communities all across the United States, and we have seen the impacts, from polluting the water supply to the noise these facilities bring to the neighborhoods closest to them."

open_questions: No SF Planning case number exists yet (none had been filed as of the Chronicle's Sept 2026 report) -- open_questions rather than a guessed PRJ number.

The Chronicle attributes current ownership to R.P. Stagg & Co. LLC and the proposal to Nestory Park Capital (David Flaherty, Flair Diversified Properties); neither has been independently confirmed here against a Recorder deed or business filing.

Whether the 0.25-acre parcel immediately west (blklot 4241003, also addressed 1215 Michigan St) is part of the same proposal is not stated in the source; left out of this record's geometry pending confirmation.
No named neighborhood group or Dogpatch-specific opposition statement on this project specifically has been found yet, distinct from the citywide data-center moratorium debate.
